# AI-directed development record — vidgen

**Established:** 2026-11-19. This is an evolving process record, not proof that every past contribution was generated by AI.

## Development relationship

**Director:** defines the problem, creative/product direction, constraints, acceptance criteria, consequential reviews and approvals.

**AI contributors:** research fit-for-purpose options, propose architecture, implement scoped changes, test and document evidence. Do not infer a model or agent's authorship from commit metadata alone.

**Decision principle:** solve the actual problem using appropriate technology, independent of hiring trends or the director's personal coding familiarity. Favor verifiable results over a long list of framework names.

## Director's brief

Direct a free/open-source, audio-reactive abstract video instrument with strong aesthetic control, reproducible renders and optional ComfyUI still-image inputs. Keep it feasible on available compute.

## Repository-based starting context

The README documents a CPU feedback renderer, audio analysis, render manifests, and optional ComfyUI API integration. It records one RTX 3060 exercise, not a repeatable performance benchmark.

## 2026-11-19 — Adopt evidence-first AI development

**Decision:** distinguish human direction from agent contributions in milestone documentation; record important architecture and product choices, director interventions, rejected approaches, tests and known unknowns. Use branches and reviewable PRs.

**Reason:** the portfolio should demonstrate skill directing AI-assisted development and accountability for outcomes, not suggest every line was manually authored.

**Status:** prospective standard, initially documented here. Existing project-specific instructions, approval gates and decision records take precedence. Do not backfill unverified history.

## Verification boundaries

Do not claim real-time performance, generic model-weight licensing or finished music-video quality. Existing documentation distinguishes implemented CLI features from proposed MIDI, GPU and real-time modes.

## Next review

Produce and review a representative complete audiovisual render; note aesthetic interventions and commands used.

## Recording later decisions

At a consequential milestone, add a short dated entry with **decision, alternatives, evidence, human review, result, remaining limits**. Use existing canonical logs when present and link them here instead of making conflicting parallel records. Keep confidential material out of public-facing case studies.
